mentions.name: Mechstain
mentions.description: Mechstain is a top-down ARPG in which the player creates and pilots voxel-based mechs. Instead of traditional gear, the mech has a physical voxel footprint that the player fits weapons and components inside; managing space, power, and mass determines the mech's stats and abilities, essentially a bin packing problem. It remixes Diablo 2 with Kerbal Space Program, and a 3D artist was recently onboarded to improve the visuals.
